subject: Updating Metadata Fields
text:
Hey team,

I had a discussion with our support engineers about updating metadata
fields and what can be done for this.

The best approach for this is to:

   1. Fetch the current metadata schema
   2. Add the new metadata field (e.g. customer)
   3. To update the metadata for an existing file; you'll also fetch the
   existing customer metadata values for that file.
   4. Upload the metadata for that file with the existing values and the
   new value(s).
